title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Quadrotor PID Gain Scheduling
abstract: We reduce vibration RMS by 34 percent on a micro-drone testbed by gain scheduling with a deterministic simulator. The controller outperforms manual tuning under gust noise.

title: Auto-Research: LLM Agents that Draft and Run Experiments
abstract: An agent pipeline reads papers, forms hypotheses and improves experiment throughput; we scale to 200 ablations overnight, outperforming human triage on selection metrics.

title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Verification for Fleet Firmware Rollouts
abstract: We propose a HIL state machine that flashes candidates and reduces botched rollouts. Rollback decisions are robust across 12k simulated devices.
